faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI Art

items.question: What is AI Art?
items.answer: AI Art is a platform that uses artificial intelligence to generate stunning artwork from text prompts. Simply describe what you want to create, and our AI will bring your vision to life.

items.question: Do I need artistic skills?
items.answer: Not at all! AI Art is designed for everyone. Whether you're a professional artist or just starting out, our AI helps you create beautiful artwork with just words.

items.question: What resolution can I get?
items.answer: Free users can generate up to 1024x1024 pixels. Pro users have access to 4K resolution (4096x4096). Enterprise plans can support even higher resolutions upon request.

items.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
items.answer: Yes! Pro and Enterprise plans include commercial licenses. Free users can use images for personal projects. Please check our terms of service for full details.

items.question: How fast is image generation?
items.answer: Most images are generated in 10-30 seconds. Pro users get priority generation which is typically 2-5x faster. Complex requests or very high resolutions may take longer.

items.question: Is there an API?
items.answer: Yes! Pro and Enterprise plans include API access. You can integrate our AI generation capabilities directly into your applications. Contact us for custom API solutions.
